resources.string: Zekke
All yours. Only yours.
Version %1$s
Create an account
Your account was created

Zekke closed before your recovery kit was saved, and your recovery phrase cannot be shown again. Your account exists, and this phone is now the only way into it: if this phone forgets your account, the account is lost.
Your recovery phrase
Your recovery phrase is the account. Nothing on our servers can replace it. We will generate one for you, and it will be the only way back into your account and the only way to add a device.
Phrase length
Shorter to write down and keep safe.
Longer to write, with the widest margin.
Create my recovery phrase
How should your recovery phrase be protected?
Protection mode
Standard
Paranoid
Your recovery phrase alone can add a device and recover everything.
Your PIN only unlocks this phone. The server rations every try without ever seeing the PIN. Standard is a deliberate choice: with it, nothing but losing your phrase can lock you out.
Your recovery phrase also needs an account PIN before it can add a device or delete the account.
Someone who steals your phrase still cannot get in without the account PIN. The PIN you choose here becomes your account PIN too.
There is no way back to Standard, and no reset. If you forget your account PIN, your account is lost for ever, even with your recovery phrase.
Choose your 6-digit PIN

It unlocks this phone. It never leaves this phone: the server helps check it without seeing it, and after too many wrong tries this phone forgets your account until you type your recovery phrase again. It is not your phone\'s screen lock.
Confirm your PIN

Generating this phone\'s keys and checking your PIN with the server. This takes a moment: checking a PIN is deliberately slow, so that guessing one is slow too.

Save your recovery kit
A one-page PDF with your username, your recovery phrase and a QR code another phone can scan to sign in.
Your username is %1$s. It is permanent.

Print it or keep it on storage that stays offline. Anyone who has your recovery phrase has your vault, and nobody can restore it for you if you lose it. This phone does not keep your recovery phrase: you type it again to add a device, to bring this phone back if it forgets your account, and to remove a device you lost.

Show my phrase

Your phrase cannot be copied, on purpose. A clipboard is shared with other apps and is often synced to your other devices, so your recovery phrase should never pass through one. Write it down or keep the recovery kit instead.

Add this phone

Your recovery phrase adds this phone as one of your devices. This phone does not keep your recovery phrase: you type it again to add a device, to bring this phone back if it forgets your account, and to remove a device you lost.
Choose a PIN for this phone
Choose this phone\'s PIN. If your account uses Paranoid mode, type your account PIN: it is checked, and becomes this phone\'s PIN too. It never leaves this phone.
